title: Switch active notebook from header dropdown
description: Verifies users can open the notebook dropdown, see the active highlight, and switch to another notebook with the header updating.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook name in header to open dropdown
Verify element visible: list of notebooks with active notebook highlighted
Click a notebook to switch to it
Verify text visible: the selected notebook name in the header

title: Create a new notebook and confirm inline rename with Enter
description: Verifies creating a new notebook from the dropdown and confirming its name via Enter updates the active notebook in the header.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook name in header to open dropdown
Click "New Notebook" button at bottom of dropdown to create a new notebook
Type/Fill New Notebook A into the inline rename field
Press key Enter
Verify text visible: New Notebook A in the header

title: Inline rename an existing notebook and cancel with Escape
description: Verifies inline rename mode can be entered and canceled with Escape without changing the notebook name.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook name in header to open dropdown
Click pencil icon to start inline rename of a notebook
Type/Fill Renamed Notebook Attempt into the inline rename field
Press Escape or click X to cancel rename
Verify text visible: the original notebook name unchanged

title: Inline rename an existing notebook and confirm with Enter
description: Verifies inline renaming a notebook and confirming with Enter updates the notebook name in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook name in header to open dropdown
Click pencil icon to start inline rename of a notebook
Type/Fill Notebook Renamed 1 into the inline rename field
Press key Enter
Verify text visible: Notebook Renamed 1 in the dropdown list

title: Empty state shows Create Deck when no decks exist
description: Verifies the Flashcards tab shows an empty state with a Create Deck button when there are no decks.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel
Click Flashcards tab
Verify text visible "Create Deck"
Verify element visible "Create Deck" button

title: Create a new deck via inline rename and confirm with Enter
description: Verifies a user can create a deck and confirm the name via the inline rename field, and the deck appears in the grid with metadata.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel
Click Flashcards tab
Click "Create Deck" or "New Deck" button to create a new deck with inline rename
Type/Fill "Biology Deck" into deck name inline rename field
Press key Enter
Verify text visible "Biology Deck"
Verify text visible "0"

title: Deck card displays card count and last studied time
description: Verifies each deck card shows card count and last-studied time in the grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel
Click Flashcards tab
Click "Create Deck" or "New Deck" button to create a new deck with inline rename
Type/Fill "History Deck" into deck name inline rename field
Press key Enter
Verify text visible "0"
Verify text visible "Last studied"

title: Open flashcard viewer by clicking a deck card
description: Verifies clicking a deck card opens the flashcard viewer with the correct deck title and card count visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel
Click Flashcards tab
Click "Create Deck" or "New Deck" button to create a new deck with inline rename
Type/Fill "Chemistry Deck" into deck name inline rename field
Press key Enter
Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck
Verify text visible "Chemistry Deck"

title: Delete a deck removes it from the grid
description: Verifies deleting a deck removes it from the deck grid (and confirmation is handled if shown).

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel
Click Flashcards tab
Click "Create Deck" or "New Deck" button to create a new deck with inline rename
Type/Fill "Temp Deck" into deck name inline rename field
Press key Enter
Click trash icon on a deck card to delete it
Click Confirm deletion if prompted
Verify text visible "Create Deck"

title: Open flashcard viewer shows deck title and card count in header
description: Verifies that opening a deck from Flashcards tab displays the viewer header with deck title and card count.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab
Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck
Verify element visible: deck title in viewer header
Verify text visible: card count in viewer header

title: Flip card via click toggles between front and back content
description: Verifies clicking the card flips between front/back and opposite side content becomes visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab
Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck
Verify element visible: flashcard front side content
Click card or press Space/Enter to flip between front and back
Verify element visible: flashcard back side content

title: Flip card via keyboard (Space) shows opposite side
description: Verifies keyboard shortcut Space flips the card to show the opposite side content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab
Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck
Verify element visible: flashcard front side content
Click card or press Space/Enter to flip between front and back
Verify element visible: flashcard back side content

title: Navigate to next card updates progress indicator
description: Verifies moving to the next card changes the visible card content and updates the progress bar position.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab
Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck
Verify element visible: progress bar showing position within deck
Click left/right arrows or press arrow keys to navigate between cards
Verify element visible: flashcard content for the next card
Verify element visible: progress bar showing position within deck

title: Empty deck shows empty state and Add Card opens add card form
description: Verifies that a deck with no cards shows an empty state and the Add Card entry point opens the add card form.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab
Click a deck card for a deck that has no cards
Verify text visible: empty state when deck has no cards
Click "Add Card" button to open the add card form
Verify element visible: add card form

title: End-of-deck: pressing ArrowRight on last card shows end state or no change indicator
description: Verifies that attempting to advance past the last card results in an end-of-deck indicator or no navigation change with an indicator.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab
Click a deck card to open flashcard viewer
Click left/right arrows or press arrow keys to navigate between cards
Click left/right arrows or press arrow keys to navigate between cards
On the last card press ArrowRight
Verify text visible: end-of-deck state or an indicator that user is at the last card

title: Add Card saves a new flashcard and returns to viewer with incremented count
description: Verifies adding a flashcard via Add Card saves the card and returns to the viewer with the card count increased.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click "Study Tools" tab and select "Flashcards" tab
Click a flashcard deck to open it in the flashcard viewer
Verify element visible: "Add Card" button
Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form
Fill in front text field with question or term
Fill in back text field with answer or definition
Click "Add Card" to save card and return to viewer

title: Add & Another saves a new flashcard and clears the form for another entry
description: Verifies Add & Another saves the card and keeps the user on the form with cleared inputs for the next card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click "Study Tools" tab and select "Flashcards" tab
Click a flashcard deck to open it in the flashcard viewer
Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form
Fill in front text field with question or term
Fill in back text field with answer or definition
Click "Add & Another" to save card and stay on form for another
Verify element visible: "Add & Another" button

title: Submit is disabled when front field is empty
description: Verifies the submit action is blocked (disabled) when the front field is empty and back is filled.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click "Study Tools" tab and select "Flashcards" tab
Click a flashcard deck to open it in the flashcard viewer
Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form
Fill in back text field with answer or definition
Verify text visible: "Submit button is disabled when either field is empty"

title: Submit is disabled when back field is empty
description: Verifies the submit action is blocked (disabled) when the back field is empty and front is filled.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click "Study Tools" tab and select "Flashcards" tab
Click a flashcard deck to open it in the flashcard viewer
Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form
Fill in front text field with question or term
Verify text visible: "Submit button is disabled when either field is empty"

title: Cancel discards the form and returns to viewer
description: Verifies Cancel exits the flashcard form without saving and returns to the flashcard viewer.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click "Study Tools" tab and select "Flashcards" tab
Click a flashcard deck to open it in the flashcard viewer
Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form
Fill in front text field with question or term
Fill in back text field with answer or definition
Click "Cancel" to discard and return to viewer
Verify element visible: "Add Card" button

title: Create notebook, create deck in active notebook, add flashcard, and verify immediate UI propagation
description: Verifies that creating a notebook, deck, and flashcard updates visible UI across header/study tools/flashcard viewer without reload.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook dropdown to create a new notebook
Verify text visible in the header showing the newly created notebook name
Click in Study Tools to create a new deck (scoped to the active notebook)
Verify text visible for the new deck in the deck list
Click to add a flashcard to the deck
Verify element visible for the newly added flashcard in the flashcard viewer/list

title: State consistency across components while switching notebook selection
description: Verifies that notebook dropdown selection drives consistent deck/card visibility across components without reload.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook dropdown to create a new notebook
Click in Study Tools to create a new deck (scoped to the active notebook)
Click to add a flashcard to the deck
Click notebook dropdown to create a new notebook
Verify text visible in the header showing the newly selected notebook name
Verify text visible indicating the previous deck/flashcard are not shown under the newly active notebook

title: Multiple decks and cards added reflect immediately in visible lists
description: Verifies CRUD-like additions (multiple decks and cards) appear immediately and remain visible during the session.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook dropdown to create a new notebook
Click in Study Tools to create a new deck (scoped to the active notebook)
Click to add a flashcard to the deck
Click in Study Tools to create a new deck (scoped to the active notebook)
Verify text visible for both decks in the deck list
Verify element visible for at least one flashcard under the active notebook/session

title: Refresh resets notebook/deck/flashcard state (in-memory only)
description: Verifies that after a browser refresh, notebooks and flashcards revert to initial state and previously created items are lost.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click notebook dropdown to create a new notebook
Click in Study Tools to create a new deck (scoped to the active notebook)
Click to add a flashcard to the deck
Navigate to /
Verify text visible indicating notebooks are reset to initial/default state (previous notebook name not shown)
Verify text visible indicating decks/flashcards are reset (previously created deck/card not shown)
